verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents cross-file/cross-function taint analysis explicitly via its 'cross-file analysis' (interfile) feature enabling detection of vulnerabilities across files and folders, part of Semgrep Code, with reachability-style flagging also used in Supply Chain. However, this cross-file analysis is a paid/Pro feature (Semgrep Code), not available in the free OSS engine, and no independent hands-on evidence confirms real-world efficacy of cross-function taint tracking specifically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of cross-file taint tracking accuracy, clarity on OSS vs paid tier limits, and function-boundary-specific examples.
